components.notes: Top-level src/ directories that exist in upstream Bun. Left alone so rebases stay cheap. Fork edits inside them are the fork's patch set, not separate components.

Fork-only. bun_mcp, bun_lsp, bun_graph, bun_host and bun_workspace are non-optional dependencies of bun_runtime (mcp_command.rs, lsp_command.rs, graph_native.rs, host_command.rs, bin_entry/workspace_command.rs); bun_agent_tools, bun_vfs and aphrody-jev hang off bun_mcp (aphrody-jev also off bun_runtime yolo/); src/file_tools and src/workflow are no crates but #[path] modules of bun_workspace (src/workspace/lib.rs). Becoming optional means a cargo feature on those CLI commands plus the bun-<name> plugin route; no dependents outside the runtime.

Fork-only crates each with a single bun_runtime dependent: bun_adblock (runtime/adblock, js/bun/adblock.ts), bun_coreutils (cli/mod.rs, shell Cmd.rs), bun_cosmic (runtime/cosmic), bun_env_cookie (cli/env_command.rs, cookie_command.rs), bun_google (cli/search_command.rs), bun_privacy (runtime/privacy.rs), bun_readability (api/HTMLReadability.rs), bun_system_tools (cli/tools_command.rs, also path dependency of every plugin), bun_vt (api/terminal_screen.rs). Candidates for plugins only after the corresponding Bun API or CLI command is feature-gated.

Fork crates that upstream-owned crates depend on: bun_hpack (bun_http, bun_uws_sys, runtime h2), bun_libarchive (bun_install, bun_standalone_graph, runtime; upstream replaced it by src/archive and src/tar, so this is the main upstream-drift to resolve on the next rebase), bun_no_window (bun_core, bun_sys, bun_spawn, bun_crash_handler, bun_install, browser and every plugin) and zlib-rs (bun_zlib, bun_zlib_sys; plugins path-depend on it). Cannot move without a rebase onto upstream's own owners.

Fork-only crates with NO dependent: bun_wasm (cdylib, a release-matrix product only: scripts/aphrody/release-matrix.ts, docs/project/release-matrix.mdx) and bun_x (X/Twitter module; only packages/bun-x docs and native-ci.ts name it, no Cargo.toml depends on it). Both are root Cargo members and default-members, so they are compiled on every workspace build for nothing. Best next lot after the 15 packages: move both to aphrody-labs/bun-os crates (like bun_git/bun_pkg_*) and drop them from Cargo.toml members, default-members and the workspace dependency table.

ci.notes: Workflows (file names under .github/workflows) whose steps run a fork-built bun and may use subcommands upstream Bun lacks (bun dotnet). Every other workflow runs on the official Bun canary: setup-bun with runtime official (default), oven-sh/setup-bun, or a step that says legacy. A setup-bun step that installs the aphrody-labs runtime says runtime: fork. check-fork-inventory.ts enforces both.
